card.name: The word controlled or control
card.fires_on: The word "controlled" (or "control") after is, be, not or the, in label text. It marks something being managed by a device, a person or a treatment.

modes.label: Flow or administration controlled
modes.description: "controlled" after is/be when infusion flow or administration is regulated by a pump or device.
modes.example: flow rates of each solution should be<< controlled>> separately by infusion pumps.

modes.label: Under the control of
modes.description: "control" in "under the control of" qualified providers handling radiopharmaceuticals.
modes.example: Radiopharmaceuticals should be used by or under the<< control>> of health care providers who are qualified by

modes.label: Condition not controlled
modes.description: "controlled" for a disease or sign that is or is not brought under control by treatment.
modes.example: Withhold Avastin in patients with severe hypertension that is not<< controlled>> with medical management

card.plain: It lights up on the word "controlled" when a label says something is regulated or managed, such as infusion flow or blood pressure.
